text:
maria: Quick sync — pulling partner ops + content + growth together for a co-marketing sprint around our cloud integrations. Top goals: marketplace listing, a joint webinar (45m), and a benchmark blog with replay. Draft assets: https://drive.redwood/integ-sprint. Proposed webinar date: Tue May 21, 11am PT. Can we lock? @sam @lee @nora

alex: sounds good. prefer 30m talk + 15m demo/QA. shorter is stickier.

lee: I can start the blog narrative + PR blurb. will need benchmark numbers from eng-ml by EOD Fri — who should I nudge?

sam: integration demo checklist: SSO on, sample tenant, data seeded (~20 records), and a short playbook for switching to host mode. I can provision the tenant by Monday if eng-infra doesn't block.

nora: inbound routing note — propose marketplace demo form -> Pardot list "marketplace_inbound" -> auto-tag partner leads -> SDR queue. Need the UTMs and a single 'intent' flag on the form. Suggested UTM: utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cloud_integration_may24

maria: good call. lee can you drop that UTM into the blog CTA and alex will add to the reg page. I'll own marketplace listing copy + hero messaging.

alex: wired a quick reg form mock: https://figma.redwood/reg-mock. CTAs: "Book a partner demo" + "Try on Redwood Hosted". Also suggest a short checkbox: "Interested in enterprise pilot" to route high-intent.

lee: blog outline idea: 1) problem statement (latency/cost/friction), 2) how the integration solves it, 3) benchmark summary (tokens/sec, cost/token), 4) customer quote, 5) CTAs. attaching 1-pager after draft.

sam: question — live demo or pre-recorded? live shows confidence but risky. i'd rather do a recorded 10m demo + 10m live Q&A.

nora: routing detail: registrants -> email drip (3 touches). high intent rule: visited pricing or downloaded benchmark -> tag as "sales-ready". Also want to run a small paid push to partner audience — need co-brand creative (logo, 300x250).

maria: action list (quick): 1) sam - provision demo tenant (due Mon) 2) lee - first blog draft (Wed) 3) alex - reg page + promo copy (Thu) 4) nora - tracking + routing setup (Thu) 5) maria - marketplace copy (Fri).

sam: got it. provisioning starts Mon, will post details in #eng-infra. ping me if we need a temp token.

deploy-bot: Event created: "Webinar — Cloud Integrations: Faster, Cheaper Inference" Tue May 21 11:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to participants.

nora: also — subject line A/B test on the invite/email? small 50/50 split on first 1k registrants. need two subject suggestions.

alex: ok. suggest A: "How Redwood cuts inference cost 3x with integrations" B: "Make inference cheaper and faster with partner integrations"

maria: perfect. lee, please include both CTAs in the blog so we can trace which converts.

lee: will do. i'll also add a short visual asset request for the design team (co-brand hero + social tiles).

nora: noted. i'll configure Pardot to map utm_campaign -> campaign field and set up the routing rules. will loop in ops for the partner SDR sequence. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — i'll draft marketplace listing now and share copy in this thread for quick review. if anyone has constraints on demo content (sensitive metrics, customer names) call them out ASAP.

sam: quick note — demo will use anonymized sample data, no customer PII.

alex: i'll start the promo timeline: email send 2 weeks before, paid social week-of, organic socials 3x.

lee: adding a short checklist to the doc: assets (logo, hero), benchmark table, replay landing, signup form, routing rules. will attach once complete.

maria: excellent. final: @design & @partner-ops — can you make sure co-branding assets are uploaded by Thu EOD?
